slides.texte_overlay:
First date moves that
kill the mood instantly
Showing up underdressed. A wrinkled shirt and old trainers say you didn't care. You don't need a suit, just clean, simple clothes that show effort.
Checking your reflection all evening. Windows, phone camera, the back of a spoon. It looks insecure. Check once before you leave home, then forget about it.
Talking over the waiter. Ignoring the staff or being short with them is a big red flag. A simple thank you and a smile say a lot about who you are.
Turning every topic into a debate. A little friendly disagreement is fun, but winning every point feels exhausting. Let her be right sometimes, and enjoy it.
Running out of curiosity. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I've always got a fun question or story to keep the evening light.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I've always got a fun story to keep the evening light.

slides.texte_overlay: Planning the whole night without asking. Have an idea, but check in. "There's a nice bar nearby, or would you prefer a walk?" Choice feels respectful.
Rushing the goodbye or dragging it out. A warm, simple ending works best. "I had a really great time tonight, let me know you got home safe." Kind and clear.
